scripts.dev:all: for port in 3000 5433 7233 8233; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Killing processes on port $port: $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; done && pnpm --dir server run dev:all
scripts.dev:worker: for port in 3000 5433 7233 8233; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Killing processes on port $port: $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; done && pnpm --dir server run dev:worker
scripts.docker:up: for port in 5432 5433 7233 8233; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Killing processes on port $port: $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs kill -9; fi; done && docker compose down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose up -d --wait
